insight: The open-source project that spawned Tavily, the AI search startup co-founded by its creator Assaf Elovic.
name: GPT Researcher
tagline: Autonomous AI agent that runs deep multi-source web research and writes cited reports.
description: An open-source autonomous research agent that plans a task, runs parallel multi-source web searches, validates sources, and synthesizes a cited report. It runs locally as a Python package, FastAPI server, or MCP server, and works with any LLM provider plus a search/retriever backend. Free and Apache-2.0 licensed — you only pay your own LLM and search-API costs.

modelSupport.notes: Any LLM provider via config; requires your own LLM + retriever (e.g. Tavily) keys.

edge: Open-source deep research you fully own: any LLM, any search backend, runnable as a library or MCP server.
pros: Works with any LLM and search engine
Runs as library, API, or MCP server
cons: You pay your own LLM + search costs
Needs prompt tuning for niche domains
